headline: Trump now says he wants to form an ‘AI Force’
summary: Trump announced plans for an 'AI Force' and to appoint an 'AI czar' on Truth Social. This comes amid growing calls to slow down AI development. He stated his administration would not hinder AI progress.

headline: A24’s reputation is on the line with the SCP Foundation movie
summary: A24 is producing a new V/H/S horror anthology installment set in the SCP Foundation universe. Following Backrooms' success, the studio aims to capitalize on internet horror. The announcement immediately sparked backlash, putting the film's reception at risk.

headline: A great new video game movie
summary: The latest Installer newsletter highlights a new video game movie. The author traveled to Los Angeles for an exclusive report. This piece is part of the 'Installer No. 144' series covering top tech and culture.

headline: The hidden monopoly behind your TI graphing calculator
summary: Texas Instruments has dominated the graphing calculator market for decades. TI calculators have been a back-to-school staple since the early 2000s. The Version History podcast explores the story of TI's long-standing monopoly.

headline: Zach Cregger Suggests There's No 'Cregger Cut' of Resident Evil as Fans Hope to See Trimmed Jokes
summary: Director Zach Cregger indicated there won't be a 'Cregger Cut' for *Resident Evil*. Fans hoped to see jokes previously trimmed from the film restored. The director addressed fan speculation regarding extended versions.

headline: Hideo Kojima Reveals What Happened With Sony in Exclusive First Interview Since PlayStation Ditched Physint
summary: Hideo Kojima conducted his first interview since PlayStation dropped 'Physint.' He revealed details about the events with Sony. The exclusive interview sheds light on the project's cancellation.

headline: Big Bang Theory Spinoff Features Surprise Live-Action Cameos from The Flash and Mr. Freeze
summary: The *Big Bang Theory* spinoff, *Stuart Fails to Save the Universe*, featured surprise cameos. Live-action versions of The Flash and Mr. Freeze appeared in a fight scene. Creators initially wanted a different DC hero for the cameo.

headline: The Last of Us Director Apologizes to God of War Laufey Devs After Calling Recent AAA Games 'Boring'
summary: Bruce Straley, *The Last of Us* director, apologized to *God of War Laufey* developers. His apology followed comments where he called modern AAA games 'boring.' He regretted bringing 'uninvited and unnecessary negative attention' to the team.

headline: Harry and Meghan's media treatment echoes what happened to Diana, Earl Spencer tells BBC
summary: Earl Spencer stated media treatment of Harry and Meghan mirrors Diana's experience. He called the press coverage a 'cancerous influence.' Spencer recalled his sister Diana crying 'tears of despair' over media intrusion.

headline: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
summary: Earl Spencer was interviewed by Laura Kuenssberg on the BBC. He defended claims made in his upcoming book about his sister, Princess Diana. The discussion precedes the publication of his new book.

headline: Watch: Emotional Earl Spencer says he misses sister Diana every day
summary: Earl Spencer emotionally shared he misses his sister Diana daily. He described his interview as his 'swan song' and 'final word' on Diana. He stated he was there to celebrate Diana, not to 'bang on' about her.

headline: German Chancellor Merz vows to stay on despite 'disaster' in state election
summary: German Chancellor Merz pledged to remain in his position. His centre-right CDU party faced damaging losses in state elections. Exit polls indicated significant setbacks in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
